definitions.full: H6989. Qeturah קְטוּרָה proper name, feminine wife of Abraham, after Sarah's death , Gen 25:1 , 4 ; 1Chr 1:32-33 , Χεγγόρα

occurrences.englishText: Abraham took another wife, and her name was Keturah.
The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the children of Keturah.
The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
